notes.title: Handball 21 Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38702294/8dff30cf6922545e6acd5aa2a0c71f6a76abae80.png[/img]

A patch has been dispatched on Steam. This patch contain some bug fixes that will prevent errors resulting on the game crashing and overall improve the stability of the game.

notes.title: Handball 21 available! Don't miss the Early Bird Discount!
notes.notes:
Handball 21, the Handball simulation is now available on Steam! 

Experience the intensity of one of the most complete sports!

Play for favorite team or create your own to climb and reach the top of Europe competing against the bests of the bests thanks to the official content including French, Danish, Spanish, German and Polish leagues!

Play with your friend in local or online mode and enjoy the most realistic Handball simulation!
